verdict.rationale: Jira's own features page says users can keep work up to date by tracking progress from tools such as Figma, a design tool, and Rovo AI connects Figma assets to Jira work. This is a direct but thin marketing claim, with no documentation of how a designer updates issue status from inside Figma. Missing for 10: documented Figma-side workflow for changing Jira status or fields without leaving the design tool, setup and depth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps

citations.quote: Keep work up-to-date by tracking progress from your favorite tools like Slack, Figma and Gmail powered by an AI-assist
Rovo AI connects relevant assets and rich data from Confluence, Figma, and your 3rd party apps to your work.
